title: Termination Timing and Refund Terms, TRICARE Premium-Based Plans
content:
These terms of the **TRICARE Premium-Based Plans** govern when a termination the purchaser asks for takes effect, whether it bars a new purchase, and how quickly a credit balance is refunded.

| Tier | A purchaser-requested termination takes effect on | Purchase lockout after a purchaser-requested termination (months) | Refund of a credit balance issued within (calendar days after the credit balance arises) |
|---|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Reserve Select Member-Only | the later of the date requested and the date of the request | 0 (none) | 30 |
| TRICARE Reserve Select Member-and-Family | the later of the date requested and the date of the request | 0 (none) | 30 |
| TRICARE Young Adult Select | the later of the date requested and the date of the request | 0 (none) | 30 |
| TRICARE Retired Reserve Member-Only | the later of the date requested and the date of the request | 0 (none) | 30 |
| TRICARE Young Adult Prime | the later of the date requested and the date of the request | 0 (none) | 30 |
| TRICARE Retired Reserve Member-and-Family | the later of the date requested and the date of the request | 0 (none) | 30 |

## Worked dates (hypothetical)

| Request made on | Date the purchaser asks for | Termination takes effect on |
|---|---|---|
| 10 June | 30 June | 30 June (the later date) |
| 10 June | 1 June | 10 June (the request date is later; never retroactive) |
| 10 June | 10 June | 10 June |

A purchaser-requested termination under any tier carries a lockout of 0 months, so it bars no later purchase.
